conditions: Applies to the Python 3.13.0 Language Reference.
limitations: The rule applies to the asynchronous iterator protocol. It leaves awaited implementation mechanics and synchronous iteration separate.

triggers: Reevaluate controlling source revisions, errata, or material contrary evidence.

statement: The Python 3.13.0 data model requires __aiter__ to return an asynchronous iterator and __anext__ to return an awaitable that produces the next value when awaited.
